title: Operate without paid Helius
changes: Route ordinary Solana wallet balance reads to the public mainnet RPC
Treat service-halted, credit-exhausted, payment-required, and plan-quota responses as permanent failures
Open a 24-hour Helius circuit breaker and suppress retry storms
Send one deduplicated personal degradation alert when a permanent Helius failure is detected
Cache holder data for one hour and cap future holder lookups at two tokens per cycle if Helius is re-enabled
Tag paper observations, model decisions, simulated trades, and equity rows when optional Helius data is unavailable
safety: Paper laboratory still contains no signing or transaction-submission code
Helius holder metrics remain observation-only and cannot affect model entry or exit logic
No paid service or plan upgrade is required
